name: io.github.influxdata/influxdb3-mcp-server
title: InfluxDB 3
description: Official InfluxDB 3 MCP server: query, write and manage Core, Enterprise and Cloud databases.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_DB_PRODUCT_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: InfluxDB edition or service; use its runtime configuration value.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_DB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Operator, admin, resource or database token. Required for Core, Enterprise and Cloud Serverless; needed for query/write on Cloud Dedicated and Clustered.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_DB_INSTANCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: InfluxDB URL. Required for Core, Enterprise, Cloud Serverless and Clustered; e.g. http://localhost:8181/ for Core or Enterprise.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_DB_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Management API token for Cloud Dedicated or Clustered. Provide this or INFLUX_DB_TOKEN, or both for full functionality.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_DB_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Account ID required when using a management token with Cloud Dedicated.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_DB_CLUSTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cluster ID required for Cloud Dedicated.

environmentVariables.name: INFLUX_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tools to expose. readonly exposes read-only tools; readwrite also allows writes; operator exposes all tools.
